questions.question: Which plateau, with an average elevation of about 600 meters (2000 feet), is bounded by three mountain ranges: the Satpura range to the north and the Eastern and Western Ghats on either side?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Deccan Plateau**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The large **Deccan Plateau **in **southern India **is located **between **the **Western Ghats **and the **Eastern Ghats**.
 
• It is **loosely defined **as the **peninsular region **between **these ranges **that is **south **of the **Narmada river**. 
 
• To **the north**, it is **bounded by **the **Satpura **and **Vindhya Ranges**.
 
• **The plateau **is **drier than **the **coastal region **of **India**.
 
• **It ranges between 100 and 1,000 meters **(330 and 3,280 ft), with an average **elevation **of about **600 meters (2,000 ft).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marwar **(also called the Jodhpur region) is a region of **southwestern Rajasthan **state in **North Western India**. It lies **partly **in the **Thar Desert**.
 
• **The Meghalaya plateau **is traditionally **divided **into **Garo**, **Khasi **and **Jaintia Hills**. The region from the river **Dhansiri **in the east to the **Singimari River. **
 
• The **Chota Nagpur Plateau **is a plateau in **eastern India**, which **covers **much of **Jharkhand state **as well as **adjacent parts of Bihar, Odisha, West Bengal, and Chhattisgarh**.

questions.question:
Lack of financial discipline by the government can lead to ______.

(A) excess expenditure

(B) inflation
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A and B**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Financial discipline **is the **act **of **setting specific monetary **(spending and saving) **goals **and **measuring **oneself against **how well they are achieved**.
 
• Once that **financial discipline **is **established**, a person can take **further steps **to **become financially pendent**.
 
• **Excessive expenditure **means the **portion of expenditure **incurred that **significantly exceeds **the **amounts normally charged **for **treatment **in the** country **where the treatment **was provided**.
 
• **inflation **is a **general increase **in the **prices of goods and services **in an **economy**. When the **general price level rises**, each unit of **currency buys fewer goods and services**; consequently, inflation corresponds to a **reduction **in the **purchasing power of money**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• If financial discipline is not maintained then it can lead to depreciation of currency and inflation in the economy. It will help in maintaining overall stability in the economy.
 
• Financial discipline is essential to improve and sustain economic performance, maintain macroeconomic stability, and reduce vulnerabilities.

questions.question: Which is a slow cooking process that begins around 320°F, removes water from a sugar, and breaks down the sugar into complex polymers with a sweet, nutty, or bitter taste and thus produces a golden-brown to dark brown colour?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Caramelisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Caramelization **is a **process **of **browning of sugar **used **extensively **in cooking for the **resulting sweet **nutty flavor and **brown colour**.
 
• **The brown colors **are produced by **three groups **of **polymers**: **caramelans**, **caramelens**, and **caramelins**.
 
• **Caramelization **is related to the **Maillard reaction**, where **proteins **in **meat turn brown **when **heated **and like the **Maillard reaction**, caramelization is a type of **non-enzymatic browning**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The process of **gelatinisation **occurs when **starch granules **are **heated in a liquid**, causing **them to swell **and **burst**, which results in the **liquid thickening.**
 
• **Dextrinization **is a **special type **of **acid hydrolysis **that occurs by **heating acidified starch **with **reduced moisture **or **heating **of the **aqueous starch **slurry with or **without pH change**.
 
• **The Maillard reaction **is a **chemical reaction **between **amino acids **and **reducing sugars **that gives **browned food **its **distinctive flavor**.

questions.question: Which of the following is the oldest High Court?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta High Court**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Calcutta High Court **is the **oldest High Court **in **India**.
 
• It is **located **in **B.B.D. Bagh**, **Kolkata**, **West Bengal**.
 
• It has **jurisdiction over **the state of **West Bengal **and the **Union Territory **of the **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**. The High Court building's **design **is based on the **Cloth Hall, Ypres, in Belgium**.
 
• The high court was **established **on **1 July 1862**.
 
• The current **chief justice of **Calcutta High Court is Justice **T. S. Sivagnanam.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The High Court of Karnataka is the High Court of the Indian state of Karnataka and thus its highest judicial authority. The court's principal bench is located in Bengaluru, the capital city of Karnataka, with additional benches in Hubballi-Dharwad and Kalaburagi. It was previously called the High Court of Mysore.
 
• Allahabad High Court, also known as the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad is the high court based in Prayagraj that has jurisdiction over the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It was established on 17 March 1866, making it one of the oldest high courts to be established in India
 
• The High Court of Delhi was established on 31 October 1966. The High Court of Delhi was established with four judges, including Chief Justice K. S. Hegde, Justice I. D. Dua, Justice H. R. Khanna, and Justice S. K. Kapur.

questions.question: Who arranged the elements with chemically similar properties, such as lithium, sodium, and potassium, and showed that the properties of the middle element could be predicted from the properties of the other two?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Johann Dobereiner**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Dobereiner **stated in his **law of triads **that **the arithmetic means of the atomic masses **of the **first and third element **in **a triad **would be **approximately equal **to **the atomic mass **of the **second element **in **that triad**.
 
• Also, when **elements are arranged **in **order of increasing atomic masses**, **groups of three elements(triads**), having **similar chemical properties **are obtained.
 
• The main **Limitation of Dobereiner's classification **of **elements was **that he **failed to arrange **all the **then-known elements in the form of triads **of elements having **similar chemical properties**.
 
• The **first of Dobereiner's triads **was **identified **in the **year 1817 **and was **constituted by **the **alkaline earth metals calcium, strontium, and barium.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lother Meyer **was the **first person **to recognize the **periodic trends **in **the properties of elements**, and **the graph **shows the **pattern **he saw in the **atomic volume **of an **element plotted **against its **atomic weight**.
 
• **John Newlands **was the **first to arrange **the **elements **into a **periodic table **with **increasing order **of **atomic masses**.
 
• **Dmitri Mendeleev **devised the periodic classification of the **chemical elements**, in which the **elements **were **arranged **in **order of increasing atomic weight**.

questions.question: Maitya Ram Reang (Satyaram) was conferred with the Padma Shri for his contributions to which of the folk dances?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hojagiri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hojagiri **is a **folk dance**, performed in the state **of Tripura**, **India **by the **Tripuri people **of the **Reang clan.**
 
• It is **performed **by **women **and **young girls**, about **4 to 6 members **in a team, **singing**, **balancing **on an **earthen pitcher**, and **managing **other **props **such as **a bottle on the head **and an **earthen lamp **on **the hand**.
 
• **Satyaram Reang **is an **Indian folk performer **and **folk artist **from **Tripura**.
 
• He is noted for his **significant contribution **to **Hojagiri Dance**.
 
• **In January 2021**, he was **awarded India's fourth-highest civilian award **the **Padma Shri **in the **Arts category**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Gussadi **is an ancient folk dance form of aboriginal tribals. **Dandari **troupes perform it during the festival for a fortnight.
 
• **Sattriya or Sattriya Nritya, **is a major Indian classical dance. It is dance-drama performance art with origins in the Krishna.
 
• The Bihu dance is an indigenous folk dance from the Indian state of Assam related to the Bihu festival and an important part of Assamese culture.

questions.question: Which is the first of India's traditional dance to be refashioned as a theatre art and to be exhibited widely both at home and abroad?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam **is a **major form **of **Indian classical dance **that **originated **in **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• **The Natya Shastra **by **Bharata Muni **and** Abhinaya Darpana **by **Nandikeshvara **are considered to be the **original sources **of **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• The **dance form **is also **briefly mentioned **in the **Kannada text Manasollasa **written by **Someshwara III**.
 
• **Lord Shiva **is considered the **god **of this **dance form**.
 
• **It gives **a wonderful c**ardio workout**, **improves blood circulation**, **tones muscles**, and is **good for bone density **as it is **a contact exercise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi **is **indigenous **to the state of **Andhra Pradesh **and differs from the other **five classical styles **by the **inclusion of singing**.
 
• **The Manipuri Dance**, also referred to as the **Manipuri Raas Leela **is **one of the eight major **Indian **classical dance forms**, **originating **from the **state of Manipur.**
 
• **Kathakali **is a major form of **classical Indian dance**. It is a **"story play" **genre **of art**, but one distinguished by the elaborately **colourful make-up**, **costumes**, and** face masks **that the **traditionally male actor-dancers wear**.

questions.question: Which of the following is a meteorological instrument consisting of a funnel-shaped collector attached to a measuring tube used to measure rainfall per unit area at a given time?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Standard Rain Gauge**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** An anemometer **is an **instrument **that measures **wind speed **and **wind pressure**. **Anemometers **are **important tools **for **meteorologists**, who study **weather patterns.**
 
• **A sling psychrometer **can be used to **determine **the **humidity **of the **surrounding **air because its **wet bulb temperature **is **nearly **the same as the **adiabatic saturation temperature.**
 
• **The standard instrument **for the measurement of rainfall is the **203mm (8 inches) rain gauge**. This is essentially a **circular funnel **with a **diameter of 203mm **which **collects **the **rain **into **a graduated **and **calibrated cylinder**.
 
• **A hygrometer **is an **instrument **used to measure the **amount of water vapour **in **the air**, **in soil**, or in **confined spaces**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **In 1662**, Christopher Wren created the first tipping-bucket rain gauge in Britain in collaboration with Robert Hooke.​__

questions.question: Identify the word that means horizontal rows in periodic table.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Periods.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** A period **in the **periodic table **is a **row of chemical elements**. It is the **horizontal line **in the **periodic table**. **The periodic table **is **divided **into **seven periods (1-7).**
 
• **A group **is **a column **of **elements **in the **periodic table **of the **chemical elements**. There are **18 numbered groups **in the **periodic table**.
 
• **Orbitals **are the **mathematical expressions **of **electrons **that **describe **the **electron's property**. Any element can have **max 4 orbitals(S.p.d.f).**
 
• **A valence electron **is an **electron **in the **outer shell **associated with **an atom**, and that can **participate **in the **formation **of a **chemical bond.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Periodic table**, also known as the **periodic table **of the **(chemical) elements**, is a **tabular display **of the **chemical elements**. 
 
• **Periodic table **is based on the **modern periodic law **which states that **the properties of the chemical elements exhibit a periodic dependence on their atomic numbers.**
 
• **Modern periodic table **is **made **by **Russian chemist Dmitri Mendeleev **in **1869**.

• There were **43 competitors** overall from 37 different countries.
 
• After **winning bronze at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics**, **PV Sindhu became the first woman from India to win two Olympic medals**.
 
• At the Tokyo Olympics on **August 1, 2021**, experienced Indian badminton player PV Sindhu d**efeated China's He Bingjiao **to earn the women's singles bronze medal.
 
• Prior to that, at the **2016 Rio Olympics women's singles badminton**, she won the **silver medal**.
 
• PV Sindhu's full name is** Pusarla Venkata Sindhu, **an **Indian badminton player** who was born on July 5, 1995.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a symptom of Beriberi caused due to the deficiency of Vitamin B1?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Slowly healing wounds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beriberi**

 
 
• Beriberi is caused due to the **deficiency of Vitamin B1** and sometimes it is also referred to as **thiamine deficiency**.
 
• The **two primary types** of beriberi are:
 
 
• **Wet beriberi**
 
• **Dry beriberi**
 
 
 
• The **circulatory and heart systems** are affected by **wet beriberi**. Wet beriberi can occasionally result in **cardiac failure**.
 
• **Dry beriberi harms the nerves**, which can result in **weakened muscles and ultimately muscle paralysis**.
 
• **Symptoms of wet beriberi:**
 
 
• rapid heart rate
 
• breath shortness during physical activity
 
• lower legs swelling
 
• Middle-of-the-night insomnia (MOTN)
 
 
 
• **Symptoms of dry beriberi:**
 
 
• Involuntary eye movement
 
• Difficulty speaking
 
• pain in the limbs
 
• paralysis
 
• vomiting​
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome** and beriberi are **associated **with each other as it is a kind of **brain injury due to thiamine deficiency**. 
 
• **Other causes of beriberi:**
 
 
• It is also commonly observed in those who **abuse alcohol**, which makes it **harder for body cells to absorb and store vitamin B1**.
 
• In extremely rare instances,** beriberi may also be a genetic condition** that is passed from **mother to child during breastfeeding**.
 
• **Hyperthyroidism**
 
 
 
• This disease can be **treated by restoring the blood cell level of thiamine **by increasing daily vitamin consumption.
 
• **Thiamine supplements** are administered** orally or intravenously** to treat patients (injection).

• **Pandavani**

 
 
• A folk song called **Pandavani** describes the **bravery of Mahabharata characters**.
 
• **Chhattisgarh, Orissa, Madhya Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh **are among the popular states that enjoy this folk music.
 
• This** traditional musical style is still being preserved by artists like Teejan Bai, Jhaduram Devangan, Ritu Verma, Usha Barle, and Shantibai Chelak**.
 
• **Tambura** is mostly employed as a **musical instrument**, but it is** also utilized as a prop to describe various Mahabharata characters**.
 
• For instance, **when recounting Bhima's bravery**, the performer frequently carries the Tambura on their shoulder.
 
• **Tambura **serves as a r**epresentation of Bhima's mace** while performing this.
 
• **Manjira, Harmonium, Dholak, and Tabla **are other musical instruments that are used.

• **Lavani**

 
 
• Popular **Maharashtrian folk music called Lavani** was first played for the** soldier's amusement**.
 
• The song, which is **typically sung by ladies**, expresses information about **politics and society**.
 
 
 
• **Bihugeet**
 
 
• One of** Assam's most well-known folk melodies, Bihugeet,** is performed at the renowned **Bihu festival**.
 
• It is a** dance performance that typically goes with the music** and it is presented three times a year.
 
• **Young boys and girls usually sing the song**, which reflects the **Assamese's joyous nature**.
 
 
 
• **Bhatiali**
 
 
• In **ancient Bengal**, **Bhatiali** was sung by the **fishermen**.
 
• According to legend, **Bengali fishermen and oarsmen employed this musical genre to pass the time when they weren't required to row their boats with all of their might**.
